scene: The East Wind said he had heard tell of the Prince and of his castle, but he did not know the way to it, for he had never blown so far. But if she liked he would go with her to his brother the West Wind: he might know that, for he was much stronger. She might sit on his back, and he would carry her there.
caption: "I do not know the way, but if you like I will go with you to my brother the West Wind."
